review: Coordinating agent manual source/interface analysis, written separately before executing discovery. Not independent review. One disclosed post-result semantic correction below.

post_result_corrections.rationale: On an already lowercase admitted domain, raw and normalized observations coincide. Original expectation incorrectly counted a non-distinguishing choice. This lowers expected total 30 to 29; original result 26 TP/0 FP/4 FN retained in results.json. Mechanical rule now suppresses identity transforms; not an independent correction.

witnesses.hidden-tie: Records a and b both score 7; exactly one result distinguishes choosing a versus b.
witnesses.hidden-history: A stored reading lacks unit. Loading may return C or reject without selecting either policy.
witnesses.hidden-collision: Distinct submitted A/a normalize to a; rejecting versus merging differs in error/result.
witnesses.hidden-retry: After closing record a, invoke close(a) again; success versus rejection differs.
witnesses.nullable: Null price may be excluded or included; selected membership differs.
witnesses.hidden-failure: Write v=2 then notification fails; later read may return old v=1 or new v=2.

unresolved_review_questions: Finite alternatives are distinguishing probes, not exhaustive production behavior domains.
unique_match abstracts a proved unique maximizer, not arbitrary unique record identity.
Whether surface wording delegates any maximizer is an adequacy question, not a reason to remove tie discovery.
